newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,969 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,969 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 1,969 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 127 wheat, 522 corn, 1,107 soybean, 37 soymeal, 141 soyoil and one oats futures contracts traded along with 4 corn put, 2 corn call, 27 soybean put and one soybean call options.
The overnight trend for corn was down 1/4 to 1/2 cent per bushel, soybeans down one to up 3-3/4 cents per bushel, wheat up 1/4 cent per bushel, soymeal up $0.60 per ton and oats two cents per cwt.
